provenance.self_reference_policy: The final Git package commit SHA is NOT embedded in any bundle file: a file inside a commit cannot contain that commit's own SHA. package_commit is reported only in the Lovable final response and repository history (REPORTED_AFTER_COMMIT). GEMINI_REVIEW_BUNDLE_INTEGRITY.sha256 intentionally excludes its own hash, and bundle_tree_hash is computed over all payload files excluding GEMINI_REVIEW_BUNDLE_MANIFEST.json and GEMINI_REVIEW_BUNDLE_INTEGRITY.sha256. This bundle is therefore not self-authenticating.
